root_cause: SliverFloatingHeader defaulted snap to false, so no scroll-end animation ran; Flutter always performs the partial-header end snap (isScrollingNotifier false path). Residual pass: three causes. (1) Incular revealed a floating header on any backward offset delta; Flutter _RenderSliverFloatingHeader reveals only while userScrollDirection is forward, and a wheel (pointerScroll -> goBallistic -> goIdle) or jumpTo lays out with an idle direction, so the wheel only clamps the effective offset to the scroll offset (10 of 70 visible). (2) The snap used a half-visible threshold; Flutter snaps toward the user direction at scroll end (forward reveals, otherwise hides), from the previous layout's effective offset (100), via isScrollingNotifier. (3) Sliver ticks ran in the compositor pass after layout, so every snap frame was laid out one frame late; Flutter tickers run before layout.

api_change: additive: new PaintCommand::PushMatrixFilter variant (exhaustive matches must add it; updated in incular-wgpu, incular-runtime/tests/runtime.rs and incular-widgets/tests/common/mod.rs); LayerKind::Transform gains sampling (patterns need ..); new builders Transform/MatrixTransition/ScaleTransition/RotationTransition::filter_quality(FilterQuality)
limitations: ImageSampling has only Linear and Nearest, so Medium and High resample bilinearly (no mipmaps or bicubic). Alignment pivots are fractional translations around the filtered transform, so only the core matrix is resampled. The source is the child's full bounds and the result is clipped to the target. ImageFiltered with ImageFilter.matrix still lowers to a vector Transform (Flutter defaults that filter to FilterQuality.low).
note: Supersedes animated-widgets-2's blocked record.

Flutter's raster paints on the line top plus the rounded ascent, so snap_line_boxes now shifts glyphs to top + round(ascent) while TextLine.baseline and metrics.baseline keep the unrounded value. Pixels: text 0.32/0.26/0.17/0.16%, text_dark 0.27/0.19/0.21/0.15%, text_gray 0.05/0.03/0.01/0.02%, text_align 0.18/0.11/0.12/0.16% (audit baseline level); rich_text_spans improved to 0.02% at 1.25x and 2x; no scene worse. Frames unchanged (text__ 24/28, layout__ 35/37, implicit__ 19/19, transitions__ 9/9). Test: height_behavior.rs line_heights_round_while_the_baseline_keeps_the_exact_ascent asserts the paint baseline 12 and reported 11.625.
